description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService class, which provides methods to retrieve user data from a repository and convert it into DTOs.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Implementation of user-related business logic, fetching user data from the repository and returning DTOs.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID asynchronously and returns a UserDto object, or null if not found.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all users asynchronously and returns a list of UserDto objects.
